## 2.2 ⛔ ONE SNAPSHOT WAS LOST. READ THIS BEFORE TRUSTING ANY "RETAINED" CLAIM

**Independent audit, 2026-09-15.** `evidence_superseded` retained **hashes and counts
only**. The author wrote that the offline-only snapshot was *"recoverable by hash"* — ⛔
**that was wrong. A hash proves identity, never recovery.** The offline-only
`Q5_RESULTS.json` (`3058a549…`) and `Q5_TABLES.md` (`89ad3913…`) were overwritten and
**their bytes no longer exist anywhere** — the working tree, temp and scratchpad were all
searched and every candidate hashed. Both superseded entries now carry
`recoverable: false` and the reason.

**What IS established, and it is the property that matters:** the 540 offline labels were
**independently reconstructed** from the untouched 93,744 rows plus the frozen revision-6
calibration, with selection, aggregation and the §8.4 rules **re-implemented** rather than
re-called — **0 mismatches across all 540 strata**. Scientific reproducibility: **YES**.
Historical byte recovery: **NO**, and it is not claimed.

**Repaired:** `freeze_q5.py` now copies the **files themselves** into
`Q5_EVIDENCE_ARCHIVE\<timestamp>\` before superseding a set, records each path beside its
hash, and sets `recoverable` from what it actually archived. First real archive:
`Q5_EVIDENCE_ARCHIVE\2026-09-15T182108Z\`, 6 files, 438 MB.

| `<PRIVATE_STREAMED_ROOT>` (27,776 files · 18,014,470,720 bytes · 16.78 GB) | ⛔ **RETAINED** — live dependency |

**Why retained, when the clearance says deletable.** The Q5 audit proved the WAVs are not
needed **to reproduce Gate 4/Q5**. It did not prove they have no value elsewhere.
`GATE4_HANDOFF.md` §"Later phases, in order, **none of them started**" names two that
require the waveforms and cannot be served by any stored artifact:

1. **Human listening / perceptual realism** — its own pre-registration, participants and consent.
2. **Detectorproof — the adversarial detectability phase.**

⭐ **The deletion clearance REMAINS VALID.** Deletion is **deferred**, not withdrawn, until
those consumers are harvested or explicitly cancelled. When that day comes, §3's
preconditions still apply and both piles go together.

⚠️ **Regeneration is possible but is not free:** ~**10.5 h** of GPU decode (both stores were
written 2026-09-12 14:27 → 2026-09-13 00:59, one process at a time per §7.4), and it
depends on four conda environments (`decbench`, `fish`, `decbench_melflow`,
`decbench_nemo`), the **3.29 GB `external_agpl`** checkpoints and the frozen runner all
continuing to exist. `gate4_retro_sha.py` verified 216/216 sample bit-identity, with one
measured exception: `fish_modified_dac` cold start, `max|d|` 4.82e-02, one cell per process.

**Canonical sources remain protected and were never in scope:** `<PRIVATE_SOURCE_ROOT>`,
`<PRIVATE_MASTERS_ROOT>`, every master recording, `Desktop\Legacy`, `Q5_EVIDENCE_ARCHIVE`,
and the Q5 evidence set.

## 3. WHAT MUST BE TRUE BEFORE A SINGLE WAV IS DELETED

1. **Stage 2 results audit returns `READY TO FREEZE`** — `STAGE2_STATE.md` forbids
   deletion before that, and it is not frozen as of 2026-09-13.
2. **The Q5 speaker-identity pass has been run against these WAVs.** Q5 is the
   pre-registered identity question (`GATE4_PREREG.md` §5.4.1, Q5 at line 127 —
   `METRIC NOT BUILT, NOT FUZZED`). It was never implemented, so **the identity result
   does not exist yet and the WAVs are the only way to get it.** Inventory taken
   2026-09-13: no speaker-embedding field appears anywhere in the Stage 2 rows.
3. **Q5's evidence is frozen in the form that survives deletion** — per-recording
   embeddings/similarities keyed by **the WAV's sha256**, so any later reader can prove
   which bytes produced which number. `gate4_retro_sha.py` already verified 216/216 on
   file and sample identity for the 18 arms; the Q5 cache must key to the same hashes.
4. Streaming delta answered from the H: pile (16 arms only; a cell with no streamed
   output is **NOT MEASURED**, never zero).

Only then: delete both piles, and record the deletion here with the date.
